reference.citation: Reiss A, Stricker D (2012), 16th IEEE ISWC (PAMAP2, UCI #231, CC-BY 4.0); Webber CL, Zbilut JP (1994) J Appl Physiol 76:965-973; Marwan N et al. (2007) Phys Rep 438:237-329 (recurrence quantification definitions). Reference impl: an independent NumPy/SciPy RQA (this file).
reference.description: on the four PAMAP2 subject-101 ankle-acceleration activity signals, recurrenceQuantification (m=4, tau=8, target RR=0.1) + approximate/sample entropy reproduce the per-activity determinism + entropy table and its gaps, AND an INDEPENDENT NumPy/SciPy reimplementation of recurrence quantification written from the RQA definitions (not the op source) reproduces the op's DET/LAM/RR to machine precision (max abs diff < 1e-8). Honest scope: the NumPy check validates the op's line-counting + thresholding arithmetic against foreign code; it does NOT re-decide the two conventions both implementations share (Theiler window = 0; vertical/laminar lines include the line-of-identity point).
